inner_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A newly constructed, weather-resilient sand-based inner turf track at Kembla Grange. Features a 4% camber around the bends and a generous 410m home straight. Excellent drainage par for the course allows it to bounce back quickly to firm/good ratings. Suits balanced pressers and horses that handle cambered turns efficiently.
inner_turf.post_bias: Fair barrier distribution across distances (ranging from 1150m to 1450m+). The 4% camber helps prevent horses from sliding wide on turns, reducing wide-draw penalties compared to flatter tight bullrings.

handicapping_angles.wet_track_resilience: Because of its elite sand-based drainage profile, Illawarra Grange handles heavy rain exceptionally well. Track condition recoveries are fast; don't overly penalize dry-track specialists if the meeting bounces back to a Good 4 quickly.
handicapping_angles.camber_and_cornering: The pronounced 4% camber rewards horses with clean, balanced actions around the bends. Poorly balanced runners or those that hang under pressure will leak ground on the turns.
handicapping_angles.long_straight_fairness: With a 410-metre home straight, closers and sustained runners ('P' or 'C' types) have plenty of runway, making it difficult for lone speed to steal races if pressured early.
